what_was_done: Added marker-driven-routing reconciler rule. Exports buildMarkerDrivenRoutingRule(opts) from src/lib/reconciler-rules/marker-driven-routing.ts (~230 lines). Matches on agent-exited events (event-based discovery; reads recent events from reconciler lookback window ~60 min). For each epic in those events, reads marker via readMarker(repoPath, markerId). If marker signals routing intent (next_agent set OR status=needs-decision) AND no prior reconciler-action-taken event with idempotency key marker-driven-routing::<epicId>::<stage> exists, calls interpretMarkerForRouting(marker, snapshot) and dispatches appropriate next agent via /api/fleet/action. Idempotency key prevents double-dispatches when both inline branch (kvn) and reconciler (xfc) see the same marker. Registered rule in reconciler-bootstrap.ts (~25 lines added, 1-min throttle). Added 6 integration tests.
what_was_tested: 6 integration tests in __tests__/lib/reconciler-rules/marker-driven-routing.test.ts: (1) agent-exited event + marker next_agent=architect -> architect dispatched (reconciler calls interpretMarkerForRouting, dispatches run-architect via fetch); (2) agent-exited event + marker status=success, next_agent absent -> reconciler produces zero matches (no override, fallback to pipeline-routes); (3) duplicate agent-exited events for same (epicId, stage) -> single match produced (Map deduplication + same idempotency key for reconciler loop to dedupe); (4) agent-exited event + missing marker file -> zero matches (readMarker returns null); (5) agent-exited event + malformed marker JSON -> zero matches (readMarker returns null per 28k error-handling); (6) agent-exited event + agent:running label present -> reconciler dispatches anyway (belt-and-suspenders; stale labels are liveness-check's job). Baseline test suite regression: zero new failures (3 suites / 11 tests pre-existing per kvn baseline). Build: PASS.
